svg.text: Each arrow points from a unit to a unit it uses (its uses clause). Units higher up depend on units lower down. One pair uses each other in their implementation sections (uTotalCommander and uTCFollow, allowed in Pascal); otherwise nothing points upwards.

Generated from the source (release 1.4) on 2026-11-22 (70 units, 220 uses). Light arrows go to the shared basics (uTypes, uCommands, uStopwatch, uIOGate, uMemoryGuard); dashed = used in the implementation section only.
fast TIFF: raw rows, own LZW
since 1.3: the file manager link (Total Commander or Double Commander, Windows and Linux), failing-drive back-off, fast large PNGs on Linux.
L0 … L7: dependency depth (L0 uses no other VersariteViewer unit). Dashed box: retired unit, still compiled. Versarite Image Lab adds its own units on top of these, in source\microscopy\ (not shown).
